info.name: HRMS — RBAC, Workflow & Leave
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the multi-tenant HRMS API.

Run the folders in order, or use the Collection Runner on the whole collection.
Reset the database first (npm run db:reset) — some requests are one-shot by design (a published workflow version, overlapping leave dates).

Tokens are captured automatically by the login requests in folder 1.
